description: Diagnostics of an incident of a `scenario` monitor: the run that opened it — location, duration, the failed test, the Playwright error with its call log and the test console output — and whether a screenshot, video and trace were saved. The files themselves open on the incident page in the panel. Recorded once, by the run that opened the incident; 404 for incidents of other protocols.
name: incident_get_scenario_details
title: Get scenario incident diagnostics
